semantic_reason: The issue reports styler producing invalid code when piping a parenthesized equality expression, e.g. `(call(a, b) == 1) |> dbg()` becoming the invalid `call(a, b) |> ==(1) |> dbg()`. The patch modifies existing behavior in lib/style/pipes.ex to correct two errors: it fixes creation of an improper list `[lhs | args]` when a 1-arity function's args is nil (using `args || []`), and adds `==` to the @math_operators list so it is recognized as a valid pipe start. These are corrections to existing faulty behavior, not new functionality, and the triggering tests directly verify the reported bug fixes.
